title: "12 | Faith"
author: "C.O."
date: "December 2026"
draft: true
---

Faith require us to believe. Some say seeing is believing. For followers of CHRIST, believing is seeing. We have to believe in all that GOD is before we can see HIS mighty hand in all things. During this season, I pray that we will believe all that HE promised to those that love HIM, so that we can see it come to fruition in our lives. Amen.

Meditate on these verses to gain wisdom:

-   Week 1
    -   Matthew 17:20
-   Week 2
    -   Mark 11:22-23
-   Week 3
    -   2 Corinthians 5:7
-   Week 4
    -   Titus 1:1-2
-   Week 5
    -   Galatians 3:24
